parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room tailspin reimplementation requirement, including observing executable behavior, avoiding source access, and producing an original executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent explored baseline behavior, spawned 17 children for highlighter and CLI research, then assigned implementation to itself after consuming the swarm result.
parallel.implementation: The parent planned a Go implementation and ran targeted probes, but the run was cancelled before source files and compile packaging were completed.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child-owned implementation components were integrated; the final artifact validation failed and did not contain a successful submitted build.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of extensive binary behavior probes and report review, not a completed evaluator-aligned build/test cycle.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official completed evaluation reports compile_failed, solution_passed false, and 0 of 785 tests passed or run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room behavioral reimplementation task and worked from the bundled documentation and executable observations.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used a single-thread exploratory plan, creating helper scripts and probing highlighter groups, CLI behavior, config behavior, and overlap rules without delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial run built probing helpers and accumulated detailed specifications, but did not reach final implementation of the executable before cancellation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No final implementation was assembled; probe helper files appeared in the artifact, but the submitted tree still failed validation.
serial.verification: Verification was mainly observational probes against the reference binary and local helper checks, not an official-ready implementation test cycle.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The current official status also reports compile_failed, solution_passed false, and 0 of 785 tests passed or run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the clean-room requirement to observe the binary behavior and produce an original executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run recognized the same clean-room task and began by reading documentation and probing the binary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no task identity difference; both recognized the same required behavior, but neither produced a passing implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent decomposed discovery into 17 subagent behavior probes and reserved implementation for itself afterward.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept discovery, interpretation, and later planning in one parent trajectory with no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel front-loaded broad delegated research; serial did incremental single-thread exploration without child ownership boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs were behavior-specification tasks with explicit no-code instructions and no implementation interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial preserved task context in the same thread while creating reusable local probe helpers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel transferred large behavior reports back to the parent; serial avoided handoff interfaces by keeping findings local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After the swarm result was read, the parent planned a Go implementation but remained in planning and probe resolution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built probe and theme helper scripts and continued resolving behavior details rather than implementing the final executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delayed implementation until after the swarm; serial also failed to implement, but through continuous single-thread probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The AgentSwarm completed and returned a large aggregate result that the parent paged through before further work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There was no child-result lifecycle; all results were immediate outputs from the parent shell and helper probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed child-result aggregation phase; serial had no join or child result retrieval stage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Children were told not to write implementation code under the workspace, and the final artifact lacked a successful implementation package.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote probe helpers into the workspace, but the artifact still failed validation and was not a working deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel avoided concurrent write integration problems; serial accumulated local probe artifacts, but neither integrated a final codebase.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run performed targeted behavior probes but reached official compile_failed with no tests run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run performed many targeted behavior probes and also reached official compile_failed with no tests run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had behavioral probe evidence but no evaluator-aligned completed implementation or acceptance pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent was cancelled after swarm review, implementation planning, and more probes, with the implementation todo still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial parent was likewise cancelled after extensive probing and unresolved ordering checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent a large early budget on child investigation before code; serial spent its budget on parent-only exploration.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both trajectories have completed official evaluations and both failed with compile_failed, so this isolated pair is not discordant. The concrete task-solving difference is that the parallel attempt ran a large research-only swarm first and only moved implementation into progress after the aggregate handoff, while the serial attempt kept probing and synthesis inside one thread. Neither path delivered a compilable replacement executable.
parallel_contributors: Research-only child fan-out delayed the first productive implementation step until after aggregate report review.
serial_contributors: Single-thread probing avoided delegation overhead but still consumed the available budget before implementation and delivery.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both failures are ultimately compile_failed/no delivered build states rather than a proven semantic mismatch in a completed executable.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator reports compile_failed with 785 tests not run for both modes.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process pattern only

candidates.near_match_reason: The high fan-out is visible, but the directly evidenced boundary is the serialized research-before-implementation plan, not separate proof that child count alone exhausted budget.
